name: Golden-breasted Puffleg
rangeDescription: Southwestern and central andes of colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: A fairly large hummingbird of high-elevation forest in the Andes in Colombia and Ecuador. Mostly green with an obvious golden sheen on the breast and white puffs on each leg.

name: White-faced Plover
rangeDescription: Breeds coastal southeastern china; also vietnam (1 nest); winters to coastal southern vietnam, southern thailand, malay peninsula, singapore, and eastern sumatra
description: A small, pale plover with sandy upperparts, pinkish-colored legs, and a black bill. Male in breeding plumage has a mostly rufous crown and small black marks on top of the head and at the sides of the breast.

name: Hemprich's Hornbill
rangeDescription: Rocky euphorbia areas of ethiopia to northwestern kenya and uganda
description: A medium-sized dark-brown hornbill with a long tail. The bill is dull reddish and the belly white; there is white in the outer tail.

name: Gray-cheeked Warbler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern india to southwestern china, myanmar, and indochina
description: Striking small warbler with bright white spectacles around each large dark eye; a refreshingly distinctive bird in a particularly frustrating group, thanks to its uniquely dark gray head. Active primarily in the lower levels of broadleaf forests in hilly and montane areas with dense undergrowth.

name: Spot-winged Rosefinch
rangeDescription: Himalayas (garhwal to nepal and sikkim)
description: Rather large rosefinch of the Himalayas. Male is dark pink with broad pale eyebrows and two rows of fine white specks on the wings.

name: Victoria's Riflebird
rangeDescription: Rainforest of northeastern queensland (cooktown to paluma range)
description: Large songbird with long decurved bill. Male almost completely black, with green and blue metallic sheen on belly, throat, and crown.

name: Andaman Serpent-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of andaman islands
description: A relatively small, uniformly dark brown eagle with a contrasting bright-yellow bare patch between the eye and the bill. The underparts are speckled with small white spots.

name: Oriole Blackbird
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to venezuela, the guianas, amazonian brazil, and northeastern peru
description: Beautiful and unmistakable: larger than most orioles, predominantly golden-yellow with black back, wings, and tail. Also note black surrounding eye and black mustache.

name: Yellow-bellied Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southern mexico (oaxaca) to northeastern costa rica
description: A tiny, stub-tailed flycatcher of humid tropical forest. Spends most of its time in the canopy, where overlooked easily, but at times descends lower, mainly at forest edges.

name: Gray-striped Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Locally in escarpment of western angola
description: Large and brownish francolin that is endemic to Angola. Mostly buffy brown, with pale stripes on the back and chestnut stripes on the underparts.

name: Pacific Elaenia
rangeDescription: Western ecuador (western esmeraldas and manabí) to northwestern peru
description: A plain flycatcher restricted to dry and semi-humid forest in western Ecuador and northwestern Peru. It is best identified by the pale eyebrow and the dark, smudgy stripe that starts behind the eye and curls down behind the ear.

name: Short-billed Pigeon
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of southeastern mexico to northwestern colombia (chocó)
description: Overall dark pigeon of humid evergreen forest in tropical lowlands. Lives mainly in the canopy, where it is hard to spot, although its far-carrying hoo’koo-koo-koo song is often heard and may help in locating it.

name: Simeulue Parrot
rangeDescription: Simeulue and siumat islands (off western coast of sumatra)
description: Large-headed and short-tailed parrot with a comically bulbous bill, endemic to Simeulue and Siumat. Male is green with a bright orange bill and a powder-blue head and rump.

name: Blue-spotted Wood-Dove
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa, zanzibar, and pemba island
description: Small, pale, pretty dove. Bill is red with a yellow tip.

name: Dusky-green Oropendola
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru and northwestern to central bolivia (la paz to western santa cruz)
description: Medium-sized oropendola of montane forests. Evenly olive-green, with a dark eye and pale bill.

name: White-faced Quail-Dove
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern mexico (san luis potosí) to northwestern nicaragua
description: Fairly large but elusive dove of humid evergreen and pine-evergreen forests in the highlands. It feeds mainly on the forest floor and may be seen beside quiet trails early and late in the day either walking quickly away or flushing explosively from close range.

name: Sulphur-bellied Whistler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of sulawesi
description: A fairly nondescript thick-billed, sparrow-sized songbird. Upperparts are uniform rich brown and underparts whitish, but particularly note the yellow wash to the lower belly and the base of the undertail.

name: Spiny-faced Antshrike
rangeDescription: Eastern panama (colón) to far northwestern colombia (chocó)
description: This antshrike is distinctive within its small range in eastern Panama and extreme northwest Colombia. Male is dark gray below and brown above with bold buffy spotting on wing coverts with a streaked back and crown.

name: Samoan Whistler
rangeDescription: Samoa (savai'i and upolu)
description: A small bird with strikingly bright golden underparts and slate-gray upperparts. The small golden eyebrow reaches the eye but doesn’t extend behind it.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Northern Grosbeak-Canary
rangeDescription: Southern ethiopia and somalia to northern kenya; isolated population in taita hills
description: A large seedeater with a very large pinkish bill. Males are brownish-olive above and yellow below with a diffuse but noticeable head pattern; females are brown above and white below with heavy streaking all over the body.
